hero.subtitle: MOT7KM powers modern restaurants and cafes with ultra-fast, elegant digital menus. Instant QR scan, 3D interactive promotional banners, and live insights with zero app downloads.

summary.title: What is MOT7KM Platform?
summary.description: MOT7KM is an enterprise-grade cloud ecosystem built for restaurants, cafes, and hospitality businesses. It transforms static paper menus and clunky PDFs into interactive, high-performance web experiences that delight guests and accelerate revenue.

speed.title: Lightning-Fast Agility
speed.description: Menus load in fractions of a second on any smartphone with zero app downloads or complicated sign-ups.

control.title: Centralized Cloud Control
control.description: Update prices instantly, upload rich food photography, and toggle out-of-stock items in real time with one click.

growth.title: Higher Sales & Order Value
growth.description: Dynamic promotional sliders and featured highlights drive customer interest toward high-margin menu items, increasing ticket size by up to 35%.

comparison.title: Why Choose MOT7KM Over Static PDF Menus?
comparison.subtitle: A quick glance at traditional menus versus the modern MOT7KM experience
oldWayPoints: Heavy file sizes take forever to download on mobile cellular data.
Awkward pinching and zooming on small screens disrupts dining flow.
Costly reprinting cycles every time a single ingredient or price changes.
Zero customer data or analytics on what guests actually view.
newWayPoints: Instant launch in under 0.3 seconds directly upon QR code scan.
100% responsive mobile-first UI with automatic dark & light theme support.
Instant live updates for prices, specials, and stock with zero reprint cost.
Cinematic interactive promotional sliders boosting high-margin dishes.

features.title: Everything You Need for an Elite Menu
features.description: Engineered with modern tools to elevate customer ordering and give restaurant operators effortless control.

qr.title: Instant Smart QR Code Scanning
qr.description: Custom branded QR codes for tables and packaging. Opens straight in the mobile browser without installing anything.

cinematic.title: 3D Coverflow Promotional Sliders
cinematic.description: Highlight today's specials and high-margin dishes with a smooth, responsive 3D coverflow carousel inspired by Apple.

customization.title: Custom Brand Palette & Typography
customization.description: Fine-tune your brand colors, custom logo, cinematic cover photography, and typography to reflect your restaurant identity.

sync.title: Live Inventory & Price Updates
sync.description: Run out of an ingredient? Hide dishes instantly. Update pricing and seasonal items without any reprinting hassle.

bilingual.title: Native Arabic & English Support
bilingual.description: Seamless RTL and LTR directionality paired with elegant typography (Cairo & Roboto) for locals and tourists alike.

themes.title: Dark & Light Mode Integration
themes.description: Adaptive theme support designed to blend seamlessly with dimly-lit dining atmospheres and daylight cafes.
